name: An Apprentice's Enchantment
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. narrative.details:
Here you are, adventurer. The gem only needs to be pressed against one of the pedestals near the base of the tower to activate its defenses. Use it when you're ready to enter the tower and find Trelane's remaining items.

Good luck to you. I'll be awaiting your return here at the camp. Oh, and speak to Skuerto before you leave. He'll give you the rest of the details you'll need.
narrative.offerRewardText:
Good, good.

If there are no other delays, how about we get started?

chain.subtitle: 7 quests from level 32 to 39, 18,500 XP in all.

quests.name: Malin's Request
quests.objectiveText: Find Skuerto at Refuge Pointe in the Arathi Highlands.

quests.name: Worth Its Weight in Gold
quests.objectiveText: Find 10 Witherbark Tusks, 4 Witherbark Medicine Pouches and a Shadow Hunter Knife for Apprentice Kryten at Refuge Pointe.

quests.name: Wand over Fist
quests.objectiveText: Find Trelane's Wand of Invocation and return it to Skuerto at Refuge Pointe.

quests.name: Trelane's Defenses
quests.objectiveText: Find an Azure Agate and bring it to Apprentice Kryten at Refuge Pointe.

quests.name: Attack on the Tower
quests.objectiveText: Find Trelane's Phylactery, Trelane's Orb, and Trelane's Ember Agate, and return them to Skuerto at Refuge Pointe.

quests.name: Malin's Request
quests.objectiveText: Take the Sealed Letter to Archmage Malin in the Mage Quarter of Stormwind.
